name: cbLocalDB
author: John Wilson
shortDescription: A private scratch database inside your CommandBox container, with a qb accessor for it
description: cbLocalDB installs and bootstraps SQL Server inside a CommandBox Docker image (database, login, linked server back to your central server, your SQL scripts) and exposes it to ColdBox through a second qb QueryBuilder and SchemaBuilder, so heavy jobs can crunch locally instead of on the central database.
